messages:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — canary failure detected for model v2026-03-12 (weightset mismatch). 5xx spike from inference-gateway, tokenizer errors in logs. Paging oncall @elena :rotating_light:

elena: on it, taking pager. opening bridge. pls post short impact summary.

jasper: noticing tokenization mismatch: tokenizer.vocab seems to be from v2026-02-28 while weights are v2026-03-12. mismatch causes OOV tokens -> decode exceptions -> 5xx.

matt: confirmed a deploy job pushed weightset W-87b instead of W-87a due to tag collision in artifact registry. logs: `ERROR decode: unknown token id 50213` repeated.

sam: cs reports a small number of customers seeing garbled outputs and a few aborted requests. volume ~3% of traffic, latency also up.

elena: severity P1 because customer-facing errors. setting incident channel and escalation. jasper, can you roll back canary and flip feature flag to stop rollout?

jasper: running rollback now. executing kill-switch — using console CLI to disable auto-rollout.

jasper: command I'll run:
```
rwctl rollout flip --model-id=redwood/chat-xt-la --flag=rollout_enabled --value=false --reason="canary-weightset-mismatch"
```

deploy-bot: deploy job acknowledged. Rolling back canary to previous stable weightset W-86z.

infra-bot: autoscaler and routing adjusted to route all canary traffic back to stable pool.

matt: tail of the canary pods after rollback: `INFO serving: loaded weightset W-86z`, tokenizer load success. no decode exceptions in last 30s.

sam: CS update drafted: "We observed a partial rollout of a mismatched model artifact causing some requests to error. We rolled back the canary and disabled the rollout flag. Investigating root cause and will follow up."

tara: recording impacted customers list from support: acct-129, acct-402, acct-771. severity: degraded but data not exposed.

elena: good. set incident status -> mitigation in progress. jasper, keep monitoring; if errors remain >1% escalate to platform SRE.

jasper: running extra validation sweep across regions now, will post summary in 5m.

matt: note for postmortem: artifact tagging race in CI triggers wrong weightset selection when promotion overlaps.

elena: handoff plan: I'm oncall for next 20m then handing to jasper (overnight). jasper, you take after 20m. I'll stay on bridge for handover.

jasper: ack. monitoring graphs trending back to baseline. will continue 1:1 checks on error rate and token decode errors.

deploy-bot: Canaries rolled back and rollout flag disabled. Incident channel created.

elena: thanks everyone. opening incident tracking ticket with severity P1 and linking runbook. postmortem owners: matt + jasper.

matt: adding immediate mitigation action item: add CI check to verify tokenizer and weightset tags match before promotion.

tara: customer-notify: scheduled 1hr follow-up email and template ready.

jasper: final check: errors at 0.2% over last 2min, latency normalized. marking mitigation complete, keeping incident open for root cause and remediation tasks.
